headline: President Bush created a commission and a task force to review care and services for service members returning wounded from the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan.
what_it_does: This order set up a commission to look at how the government cares for wounded service members returning from war. It also created a task force focused on service members returning from the Global War on Terror. Based on the title, both groups were meant to study and advise on care and services rather than change benefits directly.

who_it_affects.group: Wounded service members returning from Iraq and Afghanistan
who_it_affects.how: Their medical care and support services were the subject of the commission's and task force's review.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that serve military members and veterans
who_it_affects.how: They were likely asked to take part in or support the review of care for returning service members.
